fixture_name: NE Edmonton Ring Road planning-stage RSA — Canada TAC planning (real sample, Alberta Transportation 2009)
subject: judge-baseline

justifications.substance: Sub-standard systems-service spacing (1970 m / 1670 m vs 3000 m preferred) driving weaving-related rear-end/sideswipe mechanisms at a major system interchange is substantive planning-stage safety content for this scheme.
justifications.evidence_grounding: Pivotal spacing/functional-operating-area claim is verbatim quoted from EV-CA-039 and network-propagation from EV-CA-003; staging-based demand inference is transparently labelled in assumptions and confidence.
justifications.jurisdiction_correctness: Correctly framed as a safety concern under CRSAG planning-stage objectives without asserting a standards-compliance breach, keeping the preferred-vs-mandatory spacing distinction clean.
justifications.recommendation_quality: Offers two specific, standard remedies (relocate to 3000 m spacing or collector-distributor roadways removing weave from the functional area) with a 2041-volume verification step, though relocation feasibility is left untested.
justifications.vru_coverage: VRUs are not applicable on a fully access-controlled mainline, and this is explicitly acknowledged with road-user scope limited to vehicle occupants.
